children: Greenbrier's CEO and President Lorie Tekorius plans to retire Jan. 6, 2027, after more than three decades with the freight railcar manufacturer. Tekorius joined Greenbrier in 1995 and rose through roles including CFO and COO before becoming CEO in 2022. Board Chair Admiral Thomas B. Fargo credited her with streamlining the business and improving profitability while navigating market challenges. Tekorius won't stand for board re-election at the 2027 annual meeting but is expected to provide transition services after her departure.
